entries.use: Root development dependency paired with Vitest; the repository workflows invoke `vitest run`, not the Vitest UI server.

entries.use: Vue peer and development dependency for the Vue wrapper and its consumer tests.
entries.reachable: The high finding flows from the SSR renderer XSS advisory; client-side wrapper usage does not itself execute the SSR renderer. A downstream consumer using Vue SSR may reach it.
